name: shiksha-chat-tutorial
title: Ask, practise and explain

chapters.caption: 01  Open a course from the Teaching Assistant library, then choose Start Chat.
02  Choose an answer depth, then ask a focused question.
03  Follow context preparation and the streamed course explanation.
04  Open the generated concept inventory in the actual artifact pane.
05  Select an answer and explain the reasoning before submitting.
06  Review the result and tutor feedback. One answer is not proof of mastery.

capture: Actual unchanged React frontend; scripted interactions, synthetic course data and in-memory API responses.
timing: Captured frames are paced for readability, not a performance benchmark.
isolation: Fresh browser context. External services blocked; all API calls simulated. No remote course creation.
